Title: CLI Framework - Attribute-Based Command System
Content:
## CLI Framework Architecture

This solution provides an attribute-based CLI command framework for desktop applications that run as background services.

### Purpose
Enable users to configure and manage the application **before** it boots. The CLI runs first, executes commands, and then either:
- Exits (if a command was executed)
- Allows the main application to continue booting (if no command was specified)

### Core Components
- **Attributes:** 
  - `[CliSurface]` - Marks classes as CLI command surfaces (required for discovery)
  - `[CliCommand]` - For methods
  - `[CliParam]` - For parameters
- **Service:** `CliService` implements `ICliService` for command registration and execution
- **Models:** 
  - `CliCommandDescriptor` and `CliParameterDescriptor` for metadata
  - `CliExecutionResult` for boot flow control
- **Extensions:** Helper methods for easy setup and execution

### Usage Pattern
```csharp
[CliSurface]  // REQUIRED for discovery
public class ConfigCommands 
{
    [CliCommand("configure")]
    public void Configure(
        [CliParam("setting")] string setting, 
        [CliParam("value")] string value) 
    {
        // Save configuration
    }
}

// In Program.cs
var service = new CliService();
service.RegisterFromCurrentAssembly(); // Only finds [CliSurface] classes

var result = service.ParseAndExecute(args);

if (!result.ShouldContinueBoot)
{
    // Command executed, exit application
    return result.ExitCode ?? 0;
}

// No command specified, start the main application
Console.WriteLine("Starting background service...");
```

### Key Features
- **Explicit opt-in via `[CliSurface]`** - Only marked classes are discovered
- Auto-discovery of command classes and methods
- Attribute-based parameter binding
- Type conversion (primitives, enums, arrays, lists)
- Required parameter validation
- Default value support
- Case-insensitive command matching
- Built-in help system (`help`, `--help`, `-h`)
- **Boot flow control via `CliExecutionResult`**
- Async command support (Task, Task<CliExecutionResult>)

### Boot Flow

| Scenario | ShouldContinueBoot | ExitCode | Behavior |
|----------|-------------------|----------|----------|
| No command | `true` | null | App boots normally |
| Command executed | `false` | 0 | Exits after command |
| Help shown | `false` | 0 | Exits after help |
| Unknown command | `false` | 1 | Exits with error |

### Design Decisions
- **`[CliSurface]` required** - Classes must be explicitly marked for CLI discovery
- Commands are typically void methods (no return value handling)
- Commands can return `CliExecutionResult` for custom boot flow control
- Parameters must be explicitly marked with `[CliParam]`
- Static and instance command classes supported
- No external dependencies beyond .NET standard library
- Help is automatically generated from attribute metadata
- **CLI is pre-boot only** - commands prevent application from starting
